title: Rebecca Soler
summary:
Rebecca Soler (second name pronounced "so-lair" ), sometimes credited under the name of Jessica Paquet, is an American voice actress, who works on the properties of 4Kids Entertainment. In Huntik: Secrets & Seekers, she does the voice for Sophie Casterwill. She is also known for her roles as Tecna and Setlla in fellow Rainbow-production Winx Club, as well as many other roles in anime and animation. 

Soler was born on the 24th of August 1976 in Boston, Massachusetts. She got married to Christopher L. Graves and has a daughter born in 2020.
